name: Long Distance Love
source: Ivy, a middle schooler, has two friends, Philip and Dawn. Philip is her crush, and one day he doesn’t come to school. She’s worried, but remembers to calm down and not think about it. When she later goes to his house, what will ensue?
translation: 艾薇是一名中学生，有两个朋友：菲利普和道恩。菲利普是她的暗恋对象，有一天他没有来上学。她很担心，但记得要冷静，不要去想。当她后来去他家时，会发生什么呢？
